    EG1 - Enum constant in enum class it.polimi.ingsw.model.effects.Effect
    At the end of the game, the player gains double the prestige points indicated on the Builder cards in their tribe.
    EG2 - Enum constant in enum class it.polimi.ingsw.model.effects.Effect
    At the end of the game, the player gains 6 prestige points for each set of 6 different Character cards in their tribe.
    EG3 - Enum constant in enum class it.polimi.ingsw.model.effects.Effect
    At the end of the game, the player gains the indicated amount of prestige points for each Character card of the indicated type in their tribe.
    EG4 - Enum constant in enum class it.polimi.ingsw.model.effects.Effect
    At the end of the game, the player gains 25 additional prestige p oints.
    EH - Enum constant in enum class it.polimi.ingsw.model.effects.Effect
    During the Hunt event, the player takes 1 food token and gains 1 additional prestige point for each Hunter in their tribe.

    ES1 - Enum constant in enum class it.polimi.ingsw.model.effects.Effect
    During the Sustenance event, the player has a discount of 1 food token on the total they would have to pay, for each of the indicated Character in they tribe (Artists/Inventors/Gatherers).
    ESC1 - Enum constant in enum class it.polimi.ingsw.model.effects.Effect
    During the ShamanicRitual event, the player does not lose prestige points if they have fewer star icons than all other players.
    ESC2 - Enum constant in enum class it.polimi.ingsw.model.effects.Effect
    During the ShamanicRitual event, the player's tribe has 3 additional star icons.
    ESC3 - Enum constant in enum class it.polimi.ingsw.model.effects.Effect
    During the ShamanicRitual event, if the player has more icons than any of the other players, they gain double the indicated prestige points.
    ET1 - Enum constant in enum class it.polimi.ingsw.model.effects.Effect
    If at the end of their turn (also during the last round), when the player moves their Totem back to the Order tile, they place it in a space that provides a bonus in food, they immediately take 1 additional food token.
    ET2 - Enum constant in enum class it.polimi.ingsw.model.effects.Effect
    After resolving all actions (once all Totems have been moved back to the Order tile), the player can take 1 additional card (paying its cost in case of a Building) from the top row.
